summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of MBG B2B E-Commerce platform. Tested 39 backend API endpoints and 14 frontend flows including customer checkout, payment simulation, order history, and full admin panel functionality. All critical features working correctly.

backend_issues.notes: Backend returns 201 (Created) for POST operations which is correct REST practice. All 39 API tests passing.

passed_tests: Backend: Health check returns status ok, db_connected true, payment_mode simulation
Backend: GET /api/home returns 7 categories with 38 products total
Backend: Search filter works (GET /api/home?q=beras returns 2 products)
Backend: GET /api/categories, /api/products, /api/products/{id} all working
Backend: POST /api/checkout with bank_transfer creates order with MBG-YYYYMMDD-XXXX format
Backend: Checkout validates qty >= min_order (rejects qty < min_order with 400)
Backend: Checkout with COD sets payment_status to 'cod'
Backend: Checkout with QRIS returns instructions.static true
Backend: Checkout with E-Wallet GoPay returns instructions.channel_name 'GoPay'
Backend: Stock decremented after successful checkout
Backend: GET /api/payments/config returns simulation mode
Backend: GET /api/payments/{order_number} and /status work correctly
Backend: POST /api/payments/{order_number}/simulate marks order paid and changes order_status to 'diproses'
Backend: Simulate endpoint is idempotent (calling twice works)
Backend: POST /api/payments/{order_number}/create with new method switches method (fails 400 if already paid)
Backend: POST /api/auth/customer/login works with full_name + phone
Backend: Phone normalization works (+62 vs 0 prefix)
Backend: Login rejects wrong phone (401) and unknown name (404)
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns customer info
Backend: GET /api/orders/me lists customer orders
Backend: GET /api/orders/{order_number} returns order details
Backend: POST /api/admin/login with admin/admin123 works
Backend: Admin login rejects wrong password (401)
Backend: GET /api/admin/dashboard returns 8 KPI fields
Backend: GET /api/admin/categories returns 7 categories
Backend: POST /api/admin/categories creates category (returns 201)
Backend: PUT /api/admin/categories/{id} updates category
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id} deletes category without products
Backend: GET /api/admin/products returns 38 products

Backend: DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} deletes product
Backend: GET /api/admin/orders with filters works
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/status updates order_status and payment_status
Backend: Admin endpoints without token return 401
